name: Excalidraw
description: Excalidraw is an open-source whiteboard tool for sketching hand-drawn-style diagrams. Self-host it on your own server with Dokploy, which deploys Excalidraw as a Docker Compose service in a few clicks.
seoDescription: Online tool for sketching diagrams. Self-host Excalidraw on Dokploy in minutes – no manual setup needed.
